scientific_integrity: The norm and tail claims are proved analytically; 102 finite arithmetic checks supplement rather than substitute for the proof. Standard bounded-Lipschitz transport duality and the qualitative nonattainment example are credited as prior results.
scientific_limitations: Real C([0,1]); geometrically weighted atoms at polynomially shrinking locations; fixed-parameter limits. Results do not extend to arbitrary nonattaining hyperplanes or irregular measures without new arguments. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp Lipschitz budgets and lattice-phase convergence for nonattaining hyperplane projections
